xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5219: Phone: tapping an issue notification opens that issue's sheet, with status, cost, PR, checks and description

plan.title: Phone: tapping an issue notification opens that issue's sheet, with status, cost, PR, checks and description
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One vertical feature: the notification URL (contracts + classifier), the Android link parser that must accept it, the route-scope rows the sheet's new reads need, and the sheet sections that render them. None ships value alone: a URL to a sheet a phone cannot fill, or sheet sections a phone is refused, leaves the operator's tap as broken as today. The subsystem count is inflated by required one-line touches (telemetry contract, docs/TELEMETRY.md, two Mintlify pages, changelog.d, the test subset list) that the route-scope and docs gates force; the file count stays at 25.

narratives.Problem: Tapping a finished, failed or stopped phone notification about an issue opens Needs you (usually empty) because src/lib/push/classify.ts sets url '/m' for agent.heartbeat_dead and pipeline.journal edges. The issue sheet (PAN-4661) lacks description, cost, checks and what happened; a phone cannot read /api/issues/:id/costs or /check-runs (no route-scope rows); and the Android link parser rejects any path but /m.
narratives.Proposal: A contracts helper builds /m/pipeline?issue=<id>&event=<kind>&at=<iso> from a closed PhoneIssueEvent list; the classifier uses it for issue edges; the Android parser accepts /m/ screens; two route-scope rows (with telemetry and docs entries) open the cost and check-runs reads to phones; the sheet renders What happened, Status (agent from the live Agents Directory), Cost, PR and checks, and a collapsible Markdown description, each with a 'not available' fallback and no early return; Playwright proves it at 390x844 for a pipeline and a Linear issue; docs and changelog say where notifications open. Full detail and decisions D-1..D-16 are in .pan/drafts/PAN-5219.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing where question and approval notifications open; they keep /m?subject=<id> (D-2)
- Any action on the sheet (start, stop, merge, tell, retry checks, move); it stays read-only (D-4661-11)
- A new server route, a pipeline-journal read API, or changes to the /api/issues/:id/costs or /check-runs response shapes
- Changing the desktop useIssueCostsQuery / useIssueCheckRunsQuery hooks or the desktop issue view
- Shipping an installed-app build or touching iOS/Android native code (Java and Swift already accept /m/pipeline)
- Inferring agent idleness in the frontend; idle/live comes from the server's Agents Directory state
- Summing or recomputing cost numbers in the frontend
- Listing review sub-agents or conversations in the Agent row beyond a '+N more' count

autoDecisions.summary: Only edge notifications (stopped, finished, failed) link to the issue sheet; question and approval notifications keep /m?subject=<id>.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Problem and Tests name only the stopped and step notifications; the sheet is read-only, so a question sent there could not be answered.

autoDecisions.summary: The What happened line is carried in the URL (event and at parameters) instead of a pipeline-journal read.
autoDecisions.rationale: No journal read route exists, the notification already knows the event, and the issue lists the URL option first; event is parsed against a closed list so URL text never reaches the screen.

autoDecisions.summary: Use /m/pipeline?issue=<id> as the issue specifies and fix the Android link parser, accepting that an older installed Android build opens the machine list until it updates.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the URL and its test explicitly; a /m?issue= variant would deviate from it. The gap is documented.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent live/idle/stopped comes from GET /api/agent-directory?scope=live (server-derived state) with a store-agent fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md requires one module to answer liveness and idleness; the frontend must not infer idleness.

autoDecisions.summary: Cost shows resolvedTotalCost ?? totalCost and the server's byStage entries with raw session_type keys.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the desktop issue header and the issue's 'never compute it in the frontend' rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Description collapse is decided by text length (more than 4 lines or 280 characters), and inline Markdown links are exempt from the 44 px tap-target rule.
autoDecisions.rationale: jsdom cannot measure overflow, and inline prose links cannot be 44 px tall without breaking the text.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots are committed under apps/mobile/acceptance/ and embedded in the PR body.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same practice PAN-5208 used for phone screenshots.
